Sources/SilliesAudio/AudioCaptureInputQu: Retained CMSampleBuffer crosses the capture queue after its producer relinquishes mutation; packet fields are immutable. Queue bounds cover its retained bytes.
Sources/SilliesAudio/AnalyzerSpeechChann: AVAudioConverter and the chunker are used only inside the input Mutex. Neither escapes; failure callbacks run after unlocking. AVAudioConverter can retain SDK input buffers that lack Sendable annotations.
Sources/SilliesAudio/AudioTranscriptionS: Capture worker owns DSP, speech, file and session state. The lifecycle Mutex owns stopped/startup; public commands enqueue work; input.stop precedes finalization.
Sources/SilliesAudio/MicrophoneAudioSour: Capture-session configuration and shutdown are serialized on its private queue. Delegate callbacks only submit immutable packets; stopped and observer access remain on the private configuration queue.
Sources/SilliesAudio/SessionSpeechPipeli: All mutable fields live on configuration.queue, asserted at public entry points. Preparation callbacks return to this queue and must match generation before installation. Cancellation drains partial channels.
All mutable state lives on its supplied queue, asserted at entry. Recognizer completions marshal to this queue; source IDs reject duplicate completions; completion cancels the deadline.
Sources/SilliesApp/Platform/Accessibilit: AX elements and observers belong to its worker thread/run loop; request lock protects cross-thread scheduling. AX reads assert worker execution and shutdown stops observation.
Sources/SilliesApp/Platform/WindowMetada: Synchronous socket connection is owned by WindowMetadataClient under its lock, never the main actor. Reads and construction assert off-main execution; close releases descriptors/process.
Lock protects connection ownership, reads, and invalidation. Blocking helper-process I/O remains off the main queue with bounded socket timeouts.
Sources/SilliesApp/Platform/WindowServer: Request admission and coalescing are locked; serial worker performs reads and delivery. Active manipulation overrides queued discovery scope. At most one request runs and one is queued.
Sources/SilliesAudio/ApplicationAudioSou: SCStream is an SDK handle without Sendable conformance. Its slot and stopped flag are Mutex-protected; successful startup publishes once, stop removes the handle before awaiting shutdown, and cancelled startup stops its unpublished stream.
